messages:
Ana - Marketing Lead: Quick ask — can we put together a single-page field brief (PDF + short HTML email snippet) for AE/SEs that covers: security posture, SLA guarantees, and deployment options? This is the webinar follow-up asset for next Tues. Need a draft by EOD Wed.

Sam - Growth: +1. Targeting motion: webinar attendees -> SDR nurture -> AE only if signals match (commit, compliance, latency req). We should include a small snippet for inbound routing.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll drop a short matrix for deploy modes: Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved GPU), Private (VPC/on-prem). Callouts: KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 + ISO statements, network isolation, data residency. Add a tiny latency/cost note: median p50 latency vs open-hosted baseline, and expected token unit cost delta with Dedicated/quantized models.

Priya - Sales Ops: For routing, we need explicit lead signals: annual run-rate > $250k, compliance tags (HIPAA/GDPR/FedRAMP), data residency required, latency < 100ms p95. If any of these true -> route to AE. Otherwise funnel to SDR nurture. Also we need recommended email subject lines and CTAs.

Liam - Content: I can draft the copy. Proposed headline: "Secure, SLA-backed inference — deploy where your data lives." Short elevator (1 sentence): "Run low-latency, production-grade LLM inference with predictable SLAs and deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) tailored for regulated teams." Will add 3 micro-case callouts: fintech (fraud scoring), healthcare (PHI-safe notes), enterprise search (SLA + throughput).

Ravi - Solutions Eng: Benchmark blurb suggestion (one sentence): "In our internal benchmarks, Redwood Dedicated yields up to 3x higher throughput at 30% lower token cost vs baseline unoptimized hosting for 8k-context transformer workloads." Link to deep bench: https://redwood.ai/internal/benchmarks/low-latency (internal link).

Sam - Growth: For webinar narrative, align the one-pager to the three asks: 1) How we secure customer data, 2) How SLAs/rollouts work, 3) Which deployment mode to pick. Add one modular slide that AEs can drop into decks.

Priya - Sales Ops: Routing snippet — propose we include a JSON snippet for tech ops so inbound tools can auto-tag. Small example to copy/paste:

```json
{
  "signal": "region=EU,compliance=HIPAA|SOC2,deploy_preference=private",
  "route_to": "AE-enterprise",
  "priority": 10
}
```

Liam - Content: I'll keep language short and scannable. Sections: Quick pitch (1 line), Why Redwood (3 bullets: SLA, Deployments, Cost controls), Security & Compliance (bullets), SLA summary (table row text), Routing play (short), Next steps (CTA).

Ana - Marketing Lead: Nice. Two asks for the draft: 1) single-page PDF + one-paragraph email body for webinar follow-up, 2) copy-paste routing snippet and AE one-slide. Also, add 1 suggested subject line for AE follow-up.

Liam - Content: Suggested subject: "Follow-up: How to run SLA-backed, private LLM inference — quick brief". Email body (one para): "Thanks for attending — attached is a one-page brief on how Redwood helps regulated teams run production-grade LLM inference with SLA guarantees and flexible deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private). If you have compliance or latency requirements, reply with your top constraint and we'll route you to the right AE/SE."

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll add a short checklist for SEs to use on discovery: data residency? encryption at rest? expected qps and p95 latency target? model/context size? current monthly token spend?

deploy-bot: Created ticket MKT-4823: "Enterprise one-pager + routing snippet" assigned to Liam (due 3 days).

Priya - Sales Ops: I'll wire SDR play with tags. Owner: Priya. Timeline: SDR playbook updated by Fri.

Ana - Marketing Lead: Perfect. Owners: Liam (copy + PDF), Ravi (technical matrix + checklist), Priya (routing rules + SDR play), Sam (bench narrative + webinar alignment). Deliverables due EOD Wed. If anyone can't hit that, call it out now. :thumbsup:

Sam - Growth: Happy to review bench copy. Will provide numbers by tomorrow morning.

Liam - Content: On it — will ping for quick review when draft is ready.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: No blockers. I'll also attach a short diagram of deployment variants (1-box).

Ana - Marketing Lead: Thanks team — we'll run this as the canonical webinar follow-up asset and field one-pager for the next 60 days.

Priya - Sales Ops: AV call to confirm routing rules Friday 10am. Invite sent.

Liam - Content: Draft ETA: Wed 5pm.

Ana - Marketing Lead: Great — closing thread.
